media_select.name: media_select
media_select.using:
exists (
        select 1 from portfolio_items i
        join talent_profiles p on p.id = i.talent_id
        where i.id = "item_media"."item_id" and (p.is_published or p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
      )

media_write_own.name: media_write_own
media_write_own.using:
exists (
        select 1 from portfolio_items i
        join talent_profiles p on p.id = i.talent_id
        where i.id = "item_media"."item_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )
media_write_own.withCheck:
exists (
        select 1 from portfolio_items i
        join talent_profiles p on p.id = i.talent_id
        where i.id = "item_media"."item_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )

items_select.name: items_select
items_select.using: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "portfolio_items"."talent_id" and (p.is_published or p.user_id = (select auth.uid())))

items_write_own.name: items_write_own
items_write_own.using: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "portfolio_items"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
items_write_own.withCheck: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "portfolio_items"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

item_date_order.name: item_date_order
item_date_order.value: "portfolio_items"."started_at" is null or "portfolio_items"."ended_at" is null or "portfolio_items"."started_at" <= "portfolio_items"."ended_at"

item_urls_https.name: item_urls_https
item_urls_https.value: ("portfolio_items"."repo_url" is null or "portfolio_items"."repo_url" ~* '^https://') and ("portfolio_items"."live_url" is null or "portfolio_items"."live_url" ~* '^https://')

talent_publish_gate.name: talent_publish_gate
talent_publish_gate.value: not "talent_profiles"."is_published" or (length(btrim("talent_profiles"."bio")) > 0 and ("talent_profiles"."website_url" is not null or "talent_profiles"."portfolio_item_count" >= 2))

talent_rate_order.name: talent_rate_order
talent_rate_order.value: "talent_profiles"."hourly_rate_min" is null or "talent_profiles"."hourly_rate_max" is null or "talent_profiles"."hourly_rate_min" <= "talent_profiles"."hourly_rate_max"

talent_urls_https.name: talent_urls_https
talent_urls_https.value:
("talent_profiles"."website_url" is null or "talent_profiles"."website_url" ~* '^https://')
        and ("talent_profiles"."github_url" is null or "talent_profiles"."github_url" ~* '^https://')
        and ("talent_profiles"."linkedin_url" is null or "talent_profiles"."linkedin_url" ~* '^https://')

talent_skills_select.name: talent_skills_select
talent_skills_select.using: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "talent_skills"."talent_id" and (p.is_published or p.user_id = (select auth.uid())))

talent_skills_write_own.name: talent_skills_write_own
talent_skills_write_own.using: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "talent_skills"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
talent_skills_write_own.withCheck: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "talent_skills"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

job_skills_select.name: job_skills_select

job_skills_write_own.name: job_skills_write_own
job_skills_write_own.using:
exists (
        select 1 from jobs j join client_profiles c on c.id = j.client_id
        where j.id = "job_skills"."job_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )
job_skills_write_own.withCheck:
exists (
        select 1 from jobs j join client_profiles c on c.id = j.client_id
        where j.id = "job_skills"."job_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )

jobs_select_open_or_own.name: jobs_select_open_or_own

jobs_write_own.name: jobs_write_own
jobs_write_own.using: exists (select 1 from client_profiles c where c.id = "jobs"."client_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
jobs_write_own.withCheck: exists (select 1 from client_profiles c where c.id = "jobs"."client_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

job_budget_order.name: job_budget_order
job_budget_order.value: "jobs"."budget_min" is null or "jobs"."budget_max" is null or "jobs"."budget_min" <= "jobs"."budget_max"

job_location_present.name: job_location_present
job_location_present.value: "jobs"."location_type" = 'remote' or ("jobs"."location" is not null and length(btrim("jobs"."location")) > 0)

application_events_select_participants.name: application_events_select_participants
application_events_select_participants.using:
exists (
        select 1 from applications a
        left join talent_profiles p on p.id = a.talent_id
        left join jobs j on j.id = a.job_id
        left join client_profiles c on c.id = j.client_id
        where a.id = "application_events"."application_id"
          and (p.user_id = (select auth.uid()) or c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
      )

applications_select_participants.name: applications_select_participants
applications_select_participants.using:
exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "applications"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        or exists (
          select 1 from jobs j join client_profiles c on c.id = j.client_id
          where j.id = "applications"."job_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        )

applications_insert_talent.name: applications_insert_talent
applications_insert_talent.withCheck:
exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "applications"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        and exists (select 1 from jobs j where j.id = "applications"."job_id" and j.status = 'open')

applications_update_participants.name: applications_update_participants
applications_update_participants.using:
exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "applications"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        or exists (
          select 1 from jobs j join client_profiles c on c.id = j.client_id
          where j.id = "applications"."job_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        )

conversations_select_participants.name: conversations_select_participants
conversations_select_participants.using:
exists (select 1 from client_profiles c where c.id = "conversations"."client_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        or exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "conversations"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

conversations_insert_client.name: conversations_insert_client
conversations_insert_client.withCheck:
exists (select 1 from client_profiles c where c.id = "conversations"."client_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        and exists (
          select 1 from talent_profiles p
          where p.id = "conversations"."talent_id" and p.is_published = true and p.accepts_messages = true
          and not public.is_blocked(p.user_id, (select auth.uid()))
        )

conversations_update_participants.name: conversations_update_participants
conversations_update_participants.using:
exists (select 1 from client_profiles c where c.id = "conversations"."client_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        or exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "conversations"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

messages_select_participants.name: messages_select_participants
messages_select_participants.using:
exists (
        select 1 from conversations v
        left join client_profiles c on c.id = v.client_id
        left join talent_profiles p on p.id = v.talent_id
        where v.id = "messages"."conversation_id"
          and (c.user_id = (select auth.uid()) or p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
      )

messages_insert_participants.name: messages_insert_participants
messages_insert_participants.withCheck:
"messages"."sender_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and exists (
          select 1 from conversations v
          left join client_profiles c on c.id = v.client_id
          left join talent_profiles p on p.id = v.talent_id
          where v.id = "messages"."conversation_id"
            and (c.user_id = (select auth.uid()) or p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
            and not public.is_blocked(c.user_id, (select auth.uid()))
            and not public.is_blocked(p.user_id, (select auth.uid()))
        )

messages_update_recipient.name: messages_update_recipient
messages_update_recipient.using:
"messages"."sender_id" is distinct from (select auth.uid()) and exists (
        select 1 from conversations v
        left join client_profiles c on c.id = v.client_id
        left join talent_profiles p on p.id = v.talent_id
        where v.id = "messages"."conversation_id"
          and (c.user_id = (select auth.uid()) or p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
      )

saved_jobs_manage_own.name: saved_jobs_manage_own
saved_jobs_manage_own.using: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "saved_jobs"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
saved_jobs_manage_own.withCheck: exists (select 1 from talent_profiles p where p.id = "saved_jobs"."talent_id" and p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

saved_talent_manage_own.name: saved_talent_manage_own
saved_talent_manage_own.using: exists (select 1 from client_profiles c where c.id = "saved_talent"."client_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
saved_talent_manage_own.withCheck: exists (select 1 from client_profiles c where c.id = "saved_talent"."client_id" and c.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
